live_guard.rule: Before dispatching a task class to a node, read back free RAM/disk on that node in the same session; a node below the class floor is skipped even if statically routed to it.
live_guard.static_routing_is_not_availability: The routing table below names the competent node per task class. Competence is not availability: only a live read-back admits the dispatch.

purpose: Single source of truth routing agent task classes to fleet nodes by resource cost. Observed 2026-10-18: a full cynic-cli link was launched on cortex (13GB, 2GB free) while the builder (8GB, 6GB free) sat idle. Static competence without live availability wastes the fleet.

routing.reason: SSOT compiler; cortex never links (rustc 1.96 ICE, RAM pressure).
Fast iteration, no link step, but check live RAM first.
GPU-adjacent embedding throughput; falls back to cortex engine when down.
No corpus transfer; short queries only.
